before.name: ingress-nginx
values:
controller:
  replicaCount: 2
  service:
    type: LoadBalancer
    annotations:
      service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: nlb
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi

after.name: ingress-nginx
values:
controller:
  replicaCount: 3
  service:
    type: LoadBalancer
    annotations:
      service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: nlb
      service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-scheme: internet-facing
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
  metrics:
    enabled: true
